enable_network_debug_profiling: enable network debug profiling to trace and record all httpx client requests with phase timing
build_network_debug_report: build a network debug report aggregating all captured httpx request records with phase totals and route summaries
test_pytest_network_debug_plugin: test the pytest plugin that automatically captures and reports network debug data during test sessions
register_network_debug_plugin: register the network debug pytest plugin for conftest.py to enable automatic httpx request tracing
format_network_debug_report: format the network debug report as a human-readable summary showing slowest requests and routes
